notes: The portable unnamed-join TCK checks the normative requirement that the RTI assign a unique federate name when the optional federate name is omitted. Two federates independently use the unnamed overload; the scenarios assert both generated names are non-empty and distinct from one another and from an explicitly named member, and that each generated name resolves to its own federate handle. The standard member-list response must report both generated names and the named member. This is traceability only, not public validation or conformance evidence. The 2026-10-26 reviewed Lab backflow pin carries corrected source section labels; retired Umbra overrides are recorded in backflow_section_sync.
